_note: Battle backgrounds. py = height of the platform centre (0 = top, 1 = bottom): the fighters' feet are placed there. types = monster element types that fight on this background; 'default' is used for every other type. amb = ambient animation, all positions as fractions of the image (u = left->right, v = top->bottom): clouds = regions [u0,u1,v0,v1,count] where clouds drift; falls = [u, v_top, v_bottom, half_width, 'water'|'lava']; smoke = [u,v] sources; circle = [u, v, half_width, half_height, r,g,b] magic-circle glow; fx = 'leaves' | 'embers' | 'sparkles'.
